tickets.name: Opening Tip
tickets.note: Trail Blazers and Jazz, and the first bucket of this one has our fingerprints all over it! The jump ball pits Clingan against Hayes, a true fifty-fifty! Either side can strike first here, and that's exactly why we've got both ends covered! Should Hayes get the tip, the ball comes right back to him. First look, baby! And if the Trail Blazers flip the script, Clingan is waiting right there to pounce! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!

tickets.name: The Opener
tickets.note: Lights up for 76ers at Hornets, and we know exactly who we want touching the ball early! Bona and Diabate for the opening tip, and you could flip a quarter on it! Wide open at the start, and we're riding the Hornets! The Hornets' first set runs through Reid, and he's got the green light shining bright! Reid is the lone value in this one, and we are HERE for it!

tickets.name: Tip Drill
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Hawks at Pelicans, because the first minute is where the money is! The jump ball goes Okongwu against Matkovic, and Okongwu has the springs tonight! This opening could break either way, so we're ready for both! If Okongwu controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look! If the Pelicans get there first, Matkovic is who we want firing! Every one of our picks is a way to win the opening bucket, and every one of them cashes!

If the Bucks steal the tip or get the first stop, Turner is who we want firing first! And Kuzma is the backup plan on that possession, a fine backup plan at that! One bucket from any of them and we're cashing. Wakey wakey, eggs and bakey!

tickets.name: Get on the Board
tickets.note: Next up, Kings at Grizzlies, and the first trip down the floor is circled in red! Edey versus Sabonis for the tip, and Edey has owned that matchup in the circle! That hands the Grizzlies the first possession, and that's half the battle! If the tip goes the Kings' way, Sabonis is the guy we want letting it fly! If that first look rims out, Hunter is right there to clean it up! And Achiuwa sneaks in as the third man, just in case! Whoever lights it up first, the split covers the game. Let's ride!
